note: The remaining slate. Chosen against a single test: a working developer should not have seen it before, and should want it within five seconds of seeing it. Three per type across all ten permitted labels.

components.name: Bullet Chart
components.summary: Tufte's replacement for the gauge: one measure, a target line, and qualitative bands, in the footprint of a line of text. Reads at a glance and almost nobody ships it.

components.name: Spreadsheet Grid
components.summary: Arrow keys move the selection, Enter commits and drops down, Tab commits and moves right, typing replaces. The cell semantics people know from Excel and almost never get on the web.

components.name: OKLCH Colour Picker
components.summary: Picks in perceptual space, so dragging lightness does not change apparent hue. Shows the sRGB gamut boundary as you pass it.

components.name: Radial Press Menu
components.summary: Press and hold opens a wheel of actions under the cursor; release on one to fire it. Fewer pixels travelled than any dropdown, and keyboard-reachable.

components.name: Queue Position
components.summary: Not a spinner: your place in line, the rate it is moving, and a revised estimate as the rate changes. Honest about not knowing.

components.name: Shortcut Sheet
components.summary: Question mark opens a live map of every shortcut on the page, read from the handlers themselves rather than a hand-kept list that drifts.

components.name: Cron Builder
components.summary: Builds the expression from plain controls and shows the next five fire times in your timezone as you edit. Nobody writes cron correctly the first time.

components.name: Pan-Zoom Canvas
components.summary: Trackpad pinch, wheel zoom to cursor, space-drag to pan, and a minimap. The viewport model from design tools, in eighty lines.

components.name: Heatmap Calendar
components.summary: A year of daily values in one block, with keyboard navigation by day and week and a real accessible table behind it.

components.name: Spatial Grid Nav
components.summary: Arrow keys move in two dimensions by geometry rather than DOM order, so focus goes where the eye expects. How TV interfaces work and the web forgot.

components.name: Sparkline Table
components.summary: A trend column drawn per row and heatmap-tinted cells, so a table of numbers becomes scannable without becoming a chart.

components.name: Unit Field
components.summary: Accepts 12px, 1.5rem, 50%, or 2cqi, keeps the unit while arrow keys step the number, and converts on demand.

components.name: Ridgeline Plot
components.summary: Stacked distributions that overlap, for comparing shape across many series. Beautiful, well understood in statistics, essentially unseen in product UI.

components.name: Slide to Confirm
components.summary: A destructive action that needs a deliberate drag, with a keyboard path that is not a trap and a release point that cannot be fumbled.

components.name: History Scrubber
components.summary: Drag back through undo states and see each one applied live before you let go. Version history as a timeline rather than a list.

components.name: Optimistic Row
components.summary: The row appears before the server confirms it and rolls back visibly, in place, when the write fails. The pattern every app needs and few build.

components.name: Duration Field
components.summary: Type "2h30", "90m" or "1:30" and it normalises as you go, with arrow keys stepping the unit under the caret.

components.name: Word Diff
components.summary: Two revisions with changes marked at word level, not line level, and a slider that dissolves between them.

components.name: Odometer Stat
components.summary: Figures roll digit by digit to their new value, each digit a strip that only moves if it changed. Reads as a mechanism rather than a number swap.

components.name: Reading Rail
components.summary: A table of contents that tracks reading position by which heading is actually in view, with a progress line and no jitter at boundaries.

components.name: Copy With Receipt
components.summary: Copies, then shows exactly what landed on the clipboard and where it came from, with a window to undo. Removes the guess of whether the click worked.

components.name: Histogram Range
components.summary: A two-thumb filter drawn over the distribution it filters, so you can see how many results each end will cost you before you drag.

components.name: Column Resizer
components.summary: Drag a divider or resize with the keyboard, widths persist per user, and the layout never shifts while you drag.

components.name: Shortcut Recorder
components.summary: Press the combination you want and it captures it, rejects conflicts by naming the binding it would break, and writes a readable label.

components.name: Staged Pipeline
components.summary: Stages that resolve independently, each showing its own duration, with a failure surfaced in place rather than replacing the whole component.
